messages.subject: Project Solstice - SSA mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached (v2, tracked). Headline points for the Investor:
- founder liability cap reduced from 2x to 1x gross annual salary;
- de minimis raised to £20,000 and the basket to £100,000;
- general warranty claim period extended from 18 to 24 months.
Tax warranty period (5 years) unchanged. Happy to discuss.

Nadia

messages.subject: FW: Project Solstice - SSA mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Alice, Marcus,

Ardent's mark-up is in. The main changes are: founder cap down to 1x salary (helpful to you), de minimis up to £20k and basket up to £100k (also reduces your exposure), and the general warranty period out to 24 months (slightly worse for you, but market). On balance I'd accept the cap and thresholds, and I'll see whether they'll meet us at 21 months on the period.

Will revert with our v3.

James Osei
